answer: One concrete defense is bonded staking: every agent must lock refundable collateral before it can act, so conjuring a swarm of fake identities costs real capital rather than a free click. Honest agents recover their bond and earn fees; detected cheaters forfeit it. Picture a quartz weight anchoring a net against the tide — the stake pins each identity in place, and trusted reputation accrues slowly, thread by thread like saffron, costly to forge yet cheap to verify. The rising tide of sybils simply cannot afford to flood the economy.
